# Eric Chan 
> LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ericchanwork 

## Overview

Eric Chan works in digital solution (AI projects) in a MNC e-commerce who focuses on de-risking business operations, automation, and scaling systems with agentic AI.

## Key Skills

- Languages and platforms: Python, SQL, Docker.
- AI/agent stack: Agentic RAG, LangChain, agent harnesses, MCP, agent skills, Langfuse observability.
- Domain experience: e-commerce operations, compliance automation, Web3 integrations.
- Protocols and ecosystems: ERC-8004, x402, data.gov.hk open data APIs.
- Soft skills: product ownership, event organisation, technical speaking, community volunteering.

## Selected Achievements

- Speaker: AgentCon 2026 Hong Kong chapter on AI project timelines and de-risking factors.
- Winner: Hong Kong Institute of Architects ArchiTech RAG Hackathon. Teamed with an architect to scaffold a RAG AI agent for fire safety code compliance; achieved 90% accuracy against professional exam questions.
- Winner: Global Game Jam Audience's Choice and Best Family Game awards as Product Owner for Bubble Blitz.
- Volunteer: PyCon HK sponsorship and marketing; HKPUG event organiser.
- Athlete/community: ex-Hong Kong Kendo Squad representative; University of Bath gliding club member.

## Selected Projects

- MPF employer obligation RAG: agentic RAG system for Hong Kong Mandatory Provident Fund compliance in HR operations.
- ChaosChain SDK agent skills: agent skills for Web3 ERC-8004 and x402.
- aay: agent skills for Hong Kong cinema screening and ticketing.
- hk-open-data: agent skills for data.gov.hk open data APIs.
- postman: TUI social media post generator for Hong Kong Python User Group.
- autotext: static text expander web app with client-side LocalStorage.
- countdown: countdown timer web app.
- hypers-crew: agentic workflow POC for personalised messaging using e-commerce behavioural data.
- tradeclaw: OpenClaw-style cryptocurrency trading real-time data analysis.
- AutoOps: e-commerce retail optimisation at SKU level.
- WADA compliance agent: automation of complex workflow for prohibited list compliance.
- Bubble Blitz: game project delivered as Product Owner.
